entries.name: Stupidity

scope.note: Source association does not establish model eligibility or legality

conditions: recorded-joined-regiment

A unit becomes subject to Stupidity when joined by a character with Stupidity. Unless fleeing or engaged in combat, a subject unit takes a Leadership test in its Start of Turn sub-phase. On failure until its next Start of Turn, it cannot move (except to flee), shoot, cast spells or attempt Wizardly dispels, and must Hold if charged. No test or failed result is assumed.
